title: Is a banana the perfect pre-workout? 🍌
caption:
A banana gives about 25-30 g of quick carbs and some potassium, easy on the stomach. In one study, cyclists eating bananas did as well as those drinking sports drinks. Eat it 30-60 minutes before long or hard sessions. Banana before gym? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Diet & Food #4
first_comment: Banana before gym or banana after gym? 🍌
sources: Nieman DC et al. Bananas as an energy source during exercise: a metabolomics approach. PLoS One 2012;7:e37479
Kerksick CM et al. International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: nutrient timing. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2017;14:33
